name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
desc: AWS runtime and tooling for running AI agents in production at scale.
desc_zh: 用于规模化部署和运维 AI 智能体的 AWS 运行时与工具集。
solves: Agent demos die between prototype and production; AgentCore supplies the runtime, memory, gateway and observability to keep them alive.
solves_zh: 智能体演示常常卡在原型到生产之间；AgentCore 提供运行时、记忆、网关与可观测能力让它活下来。
best_for: You are about to hand a working agent to real users and need identity, tracing and scaling you can audit.
best_for_zh: 要把一个能跑的智能体交给真实用户，又需要可审计的身份、追踪与扩容能力时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — AWS What's New feed and the AWS Machine Learning blog launch list）。 Missing from the ledger; the ledger has Amazon Bedrock but not AgentCore. Preview was announced 2025-07-16, general availability 2025-10-13, both before the discovery window, so it qualifies only as a missing entry. Distinct from Amazon Bedrock: Bedrock is the model platform, AgentCore is the agent deployment layer on top of it. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：原候选记的是正式发布日 2025-10-13，但公开预览在 2025-07-16 就已开始（AWS 正式发布文章的引用列表写明预览公告的日期）。按规则预览也算首次公开可用，改记 2025-07-16。 首次公开日期来源：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/amazon-bedrock-agentcore-is-now-generally-available/
